comment: What the packaged extractor must make of each fixture in this directory. release-acceptance.py converts every *.apmap here with the archive's own extractor and compares the .map it wrote with these counts; a fixture with no entry fails the run. release-acceptance.apmap is the APMap 1.3 slab kept as backward-compatibility evidence. release-acceptance-1.5.apmap is a Quake 1 APMap 1.5 document carrying what 1.4 added (authorship, three nested groups) so that a changed version header is not the whole of the coverage.
